title: Vanity Top Accessorie Toilet Tissue Holder Solid Brass Countertop Stand 6-Inch Height | Allied Brass
short_title: Vanity Top Accessorie Toilet Tissue Holder 6-Inch | Allied Brass
description:
Add convenient toilet paper storage to your bathroom vanity with this vanity top accessorie toilet tissue holder, crafted from solid brass with a weighted base to help prevent tipping. A space-saving countertop design is ideal when wall space is limited and keeps a roll within easy reach.

Highlights:
- Solid brass construction for enduring bathroom use
- Weighted base helps prevent tipping on the vanity or counter
- Space-saving countertop design for bathrooms with limited wall space
- Felt pad helps protect surfaces from scratches
- Available in a wide variety of lifetime designer finishes, including statement colors

Specs:
- Mounting type: Countertop
- Overall size: 5.5-Inch length x 5-Inch width x 6-Inch height
- Product weight: 4 lb
- Assembly required: No
- Included item: Vanity Top Toilet Tissue Holder
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
